name: Cognitive Overload
description: Pattern related to mental exhaustion, information saturation, and feeling overwhelmed by complex demands.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. Pattern match based on high mental processing demands and fatigue.

solutions.title: AI Task Breaker
solutions.purpose: Break a mentally overwhelming task into smaller manageable actions.

solutions.title: Brain Dump / Empty-Mind Activity
solutions.purpose: Give the user a short structured period to unload thoughts and mentally reset.
instructions: Take a blank paper or digital note.
Unload every single pending thought, task, or worry without organizing it.
Clear your head completely until nothing is waiting in active memory.
Close the note and take 3 deep breaths.

solutions.title: Focus Session
solutions.purpose: Provide a defined period for completing one selected task.
instructions: Select ONE single item from your brain dump.
Close all other browser tabs and notifications.
Work quietly for 15 minutes on just this single item.

solutions.title: Breathing Reset
solutions.purpose: Provide a short breathing-based mental reset.
instructions: Close your eyes and place hands over your lap.
Focus only on the air moving through your nose.

solutions.title: Short Meditation
instructions: Sit still and let your brain stop processing incoming inputs.
Listen to the background soundscape without analyzing it.
Give your cognitive system 5 minutes of complete rest.
